# BorsaKaynak Full AI Specification & Data Feed
# Base URL: https://borsakaynak.com

## Endpoints for AI Agents:
- GET /api/quote?symbol=THYAO : Returns real-time BIST quote for symbol
- GET /api/tradingview-gainers : Returns real-time Top BIST Gainers list
- GET /sitemap.xml : Complete URL catalog of 685 BIST stocks
- GET /llms.txt : Primary AI Agent Index

## Primary Data Fields:
- sembol: Stock Ticker Code (e.g., THYAO, ASELS, ISVEA)
- son / price: Last traded price in TRY (₺)
- farkP / chgP: Daily percentage change (%)
- hacim / vol: Total daily trading volume in TRY (₺)
